subject: Shiny App Deploy stuck at 'Uploading application bundle'

messages.author: 39099352a3badbff
messages.subject: Shiny App Deploy stuck at 'Uploading application bundle'
parts:
Hi Guys,

I have been having trouble deploying my shiny app. 
I am working on windows 7 - 64 bit system. Server.R, Ui.R and the datasets required are all in "predictword-capstone" folder. i put the datasets in a sub-folder data. The entire folder is of approx 47MB. when i try to deploy i get stuck at uploading application bundle every time. i have been stuck here for approximately an hour now. :(

shinyapps::deployApp('D:\predictword-capstone')
Preparing to deploy application...
Update application currently deployed at
http://saboopri.shinyapps.io/predictword-capstone? [Y/n] y
DONE
Uploading application bundle...

Please let me know what to do and if i should provide any other information.

Thank you.

messages.subject: Re: Shiny App Deploy stuck at 'Uploading application bundle'
parts:
I am also having trouble uploading my shiny app to shinyapps.io. It gets stuck at "Uploading application bundle..." for a while, after which it would exit with the following error "Error in headers[["Content-Type"]] : subscript out of bounds."

Will appreciate any help and/or suggestions.

Cheers!

-E
